title: Growth Lead, Expansion & Lifecycle
description: Arrangr | Growth Lead, Expansion & Lifecycle | REMOTE | Fixed-fee project ($12K, milestone-based) + equity tied to ARR results → founding role | https://arrangr.com Arrangr is a scheduling platform with tens of thousands of registered users and hundreds of thousands of people reached through scheduling invitations. Calendly is the incumbent, and it's good. Our thesis: booking links make it efficient to fill your calendar, not productive. Every open slot looks identical, so your best hours go to whoever clicks first. Arrangr schedules by importance. The opportunity: we can see which companies already have several people using Arrangr individually. Each of those is an unmonetized team. You'd build the motion that converts them (in-product surface, sequences, landing page, pilot) and handle the replies it generates: seats, admin rights, security questions. Then reactivate a large dormant base and fix acquisition. The engagement: five milestones over roughly three months, $12K paid on milestone completion, milestones 1 and 2 contracted first. "Done" means shipped, instrumented and measured against a baseline. Equity is a defined grant tied to new ARR booked; hitting the middle tier triggers a founding title. Engineering time is limited, so you ship within existing product surfaces. Right for you if you've run PQL-to-team expansion and reactivation against a base in the tens of thousands. Not for CRO specialists (our volume won't support the testing), paid media buyers, or anyone who wants to manage a team. There is no team. You're it. To apply: no cover letter. Email adams@arrangr.com with three links to things you personally built, one line each on what the numbers did. Plus one answer: we can see which companies have several individual users. How would you turn that into team conversions, and have you run that motion before? I read and reply to every one. - Adam, co-founder/CEO

title: Automation QA Teaching Expert (Python)

The QA Instructional Specialist is a full-time, hybrid role combining live teaching with technical project evaluation. • Familiar with basics of SQL.

Nice to have:

• Background as a Senior QA and experience as a hiring manager.

title: Software Engineer, Data Center Automation
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE DECISION TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Automate the delivery of gigawatts. Every process that takes AI infrastructure from land to live compute becomes software: schedules, decisions, and todos generated from a live knowledge graph instead of chased by hand.

- Forward-deploy beside the experts. Product teams sit with quality managers, sourcing leads, and deployment engineers on factory floors and sites, and turn their judgment into systems that reach every unit.

- Deliver every supercomputer faster than the last. Dozens of concurrent projects feed one graph, so every lesson learned at one site becomes a preventive check at all of them.

title: Chief Strategy Officer
description:
Position Overview:
The Chief Strategy Officer is responsible for defining, developing, and executing the organization's long-term strategic vision. The CSO works closely with executive leadership to identify growth opportunities, drive strategic initiatives, and ensure alignment across business units. This role requires strong analytical thinking, business acumen, and the ability to translate strategy into actionable plans that deliver measurable results.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Corporate Strategy Development

• Lead the development of short-term and long-term strategic plans aligned with organizational goals.

• Identify growth opportunities, new markets, and competitive positioning strategies.

• Conduct strategic reviews and adjust plans based on market dynamics.

2. Business Planning & Execution

• Translate strategic objectives into actionable business plans and initiatives.

• Partner with business units to ensure effective execution of strategic priorities.

• Monitor progress and ensure alignment with overall corporate strategy.

3. Market & Competitive Analysis

• Conduct in-depth analysis of industry trends, competitors, and market opportunities.

• Provide insights on emerging trends, risks, and opportunities.

• Support decision-making through data-driven analysis and research.

4. Mergers, Acquisitions & Partnerships

• Lead or support mergers, acquisitions, and strategic partnerships.

• Conduct due diligence, financial analysis, and integration planning.

• Identify and evaluate potential investment or expansion opportunities.

5. Performance Management & Reporting

• Establish KPIs and performance metrics to track strategic initiatives.

• Monitor organizational performance and recommend improvements.

• Provide regular strategic updates to the CEO and Board.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with leadership across operations, finance, marketing, IT, and other functions.

• Ensure alignment and coordination across departments for strategy execution.

• Drive organization-wide initiatives and transformation programs.

7. Innovation & Transformation

• Lead innovation initiatives and digital transformation strategies.

• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, productivity, and competitiveness.

• Foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

8. Stakeholder Engagement

• Present strategic plans and insights to executive leadership and the Board.

• Engage with external stakeholders, partners, and industry experts.

• Represent the organization in strategic discussions and forums.

9. Leadership & Team Development

• Lead and mentor strategy, planning, and analytics teams.

• Build a high-performance culture focused on strategic thinking and execution.

• Ensure continuous development of talent and capabilities.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or related field; MBA or equivalent preferred.

• 12-15+ years of experience in strategy, consulting, corporate planning, or senior leadership roles.

• Proven track record in developing and executing successful business strategies.

• Strong understanding of market dynamics, financial analysis, and business operations.

Key Skills and Competencies:

• Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.

• Excellent analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.

• Leadership and stakeholder management capabilities.

• Strong communication and presentation skills.

• Ability to drive change and organizational transformation.

Performance Metrics:

• Achievement of strategic goals and business growth targets.

• Success of strategic initiatives and transformation programs.

• Market expansion and competitive positioning.

• Efficiency and effectiveness of business operations.

• Stakeholder alignment and satisfaction.

title: Partnerships Strategy & Operations
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for someone to join our Revenue Strategy & Operations team to play a key role in building the operational backbone behind our partner ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of technical problem-solving and operational excellence. You'll own the systems, automations, data, and dashboards that help our Partnerships team source, co-sell, and scale revenue through resellers, referral partners, technology partners, and strategic alliances.

Each Revenue Strategy & Operations team member is a dedicated partner to a specific go-to-market function. In this role, you'll be the strategic and operational counterpart to Partnerships leadership. You'll also work closely with Sales, Account Management, Finance, Data, and Product to make partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue visible, measurable, and repeatable.

title: Software engineer, AI model supply chain and package security
description: We build fast, modern developer tools in Rust, and a surprising amount of serious software runs on them. Pixi, rattler and rattler-build are open source and used by hundreds of thousands of developers: quant teams in finance, physicists at CERN, biotech labs, and humanoid robot companies you've probably seen videos of. We are also core maintainers of conda-forge, one of the largest open source package ecosystems, and we maintain RoboStack, which gets ROS running on any OS from a single lockfile. When that much software flows through your tools, security stops being optional. Every package that ends up on a laptop, a server or a robot should be traceable back to the source and build that produced it. We're building that for conda today, and we want to extend it to AI models. The engineering team is spread across Europe (Netherlands, Germany, UK, Moldova). This work is based in Berlin, and so is this role. The work Robots increasingly run learned models: vision transformers, RL policies, LLMs. Today those models are usually copied onto machines as large opaque files, with little record of where they came from or what changed. We think models should be shipped like packages: versioned, signed, verifiable, and updated efficiently. You'll work on two related areas. Package security. Signing and verification for conda packages with Sigstore, provenance from source to build to install, SBOMs, and mapping known vulnerabilities onto the packages people actually use. This work goes into Pixi, rattler and conda-forge, and is used by a lot of people. AI models as packages. Taking the same ideas to model artifacts. Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real-and happening daily at Coalition .

About the role

We're looking for a Major Account Executive to own and grow a book of strategic enterprise accounts. This is a role for someone who can run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles into security-conscious buying committees (CISO, CIO, procurement, legal, and often the board) and close 3-year enterprise commitments in a competitive, incumbent-heavy market, while navigating channel partners (e.g. VARs and Distributors).

You'll be selling into organizations where a security failure is existential, where the buying process is genuinely adversarial by design, and where trust is earned through technical credibility and long-term relationships, not charisma. If you've sold into security teams before, you know this isn't a "build rapport and close" motion - it's proving you understand the threat model as well as the buyer does.

Responsibilities

• Own and grow a book of major/strategic accounts, running the full cycle from qualification through multi-year contract negotiation and close

• Navigate multi-stakeholder buying committees - security, IT, legal, procurement, and executive sponsors - building consensus across functions with genuinely competing priorities

• Partner with technical presales Solutions Architects to run live technical evaluations and proof-of-concepts that hold up under real scrutiny from technical buyers

• Structure and negotiate enterprise contracts, with a strong bias toward multi-year (3-year) terms

• Build and defend a business case that speaks fluently to both risk reduction (CISO language) and ROI (CFO language) - you need both, not one

• Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline hygiene on long-cycle (6-9 month), high-ACV deals

• Prioritize Customer Success for account health, since renewal risk on an account this size is a shared problem, not a handoff

Skills and Qualifications

• 8+ years of closing experience in enterprise cybersecurity/SaaS

• Demonstrated ability to close deals upwards of $1M ARR or more and 6+ month sales cycles

• Track record of navigating security-specific procurement: vendor risk assessments, SOC 2 / ISO 27001 diligence, security questionnaires, and legal review cycles that are more adversarial than typical SaaS procurement

• Comfort being technically challenged in a room - you don't need to be an engineer, but you need to hold your own when a CISO pressure-tests your claims

• Experience structuring and closing multi-year contracts, not just annual renewals

• A hunter mentality - use relationships & partnerships to find leverage to close deals

• and this role rewards depth and judgment over sheer volume

Perks

• 100% medical, dental and vision coverage

• Flexible PTO policy

• Annual home office stipend and WeWork access

• Mental & physical health wellness programs (One Medical, Headspace, Wellhub, and more)!

• Competitive compensation and opportunity for advancement

Why Coalition ?

Work at Coalition is centered on the joint mission to Protect the Unprotected. We have built a remote-first, highly inclusive culture that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Coalition ’s exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion.

- Writing yes-or-no criteria precise enough that a grader can mark any attempt against them

NECESSARY QUALIFICATIONS

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

- Duration: Approximately 4-6 weeks

- Payment: task-based. Experts who complete their first task within the required timeline will then be qualified to do multiple tasks for the remainder of the project.

CONTRACT AND PAYMENT TERMS

- You will be engaged as an independent contractor.

- This is a fully remote role that can be completed on your own schedule.

- Projects can be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on needs and performance.

- Your work at Aptura will not involve access to confidential or proprietary information from any employer, client, or institution.

- Payments will be weekly following task completion.

GETTING STARTED

- Apply with your details and CV. Choose an available 30-minute group walkthrough call.

- Attend the walkthrough and create one original task from your own work. Submit the brief, the actual input workbook(s) needed to complete it. Input-file uploads are compulsory.

- Write the brief yourself. Input workbooks must also be human-built. Use real data that has been sanitised, or public data with the source named. No AI usage allowed.

- We run your task against current frontier AI models. If the models get it wrong, you then write a detailed yes-or-no rubric, and a reviewer signs off on the task with you.

- Completing onboarding does not guarantee a job offer; selection remains subject to written approval of the task proposal.

ABOUT APTURA

Aptura is an applied AI and data company working with frontier labs to train AI systems on real professional work. We do this by building high-quality evaluation and training environments that teach AI agents to produce work that can be used in daily workflows.

Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll own the query engine that searches hundreds of billions of claims across a variety of retrieval backends, from a distributed graph database to vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial indexes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. No off-the-shelf system answers precise questions over hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims at agent speed, so you'll make foundational decisions, from storage layout and indexing across engines to the query language and the planner that routes work between them, that every query depends on.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

title: Performance Tester Internship
description:
Overview: Scalability and Speed Optimization
The Performance Tester is dedicated to ensuring the speed, stability, and scalability of our entire supply chain e-commerce platform. You will plan, design, and execute rigorous load, stress, and endurance tests on the core e-commerce storefront, the performance-critical internal SaaS tools (OMS, WMS, MES), and the emerging AI agent services to identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks.
Internship Details
Duration: 3 months
Start Date: Immediate
Location: Remote
Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.
Key Responsibilities & Core Projects
You will be the expert in pushing the platform to its limits, guaranteeing optimal user experience even under peak load.

• Test Strategy & Design: Design comprehensive load, stress, and endurance testing strategies for critical systems, focusing on the high-volume e-commerce checkout funnels, payment gateway integrations, and API responsiveness across the modular monolith.

• Execution & Analysis: Execute tests using industry-standard tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling) and cloud-based load testing services. Analyze results to accurately identify performance bottlenecks in the Node.js/NestJS services, database queries (PostgreSQL/Redis), and infrastructure components.

• Critical Flow Testing: Specifically test the performance and throughput of key supply chain APIs and user flows, including real-time inventory checks (WMS integration), order placement (OMS), and search functionality (Meilisearch).

• Optimization Recommendations: Collaborate closely with the SRE and development teams to translate performance data into clear, actionable optimization strategies for code, database indices, caching (Redis), and infrastructure (auto-scaling).

• CI/CD Integration: Work with the DevSecOps team to integrate performance testing as a mandatory quality gate within the CI/CD pipeline to prevent performance regressions in new deployments.

Required Technologies & Tools
Candidates must possess deep experience in performance testing methodology, execution, and analysis:

• Testing Tools: Expert proficiency in JMeter, Gatling, or similar high-scale load generation tools.

• Monitoring & Analysis: Hands-on experience using the observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) to monitor system metrics, latency, and resource utilization during test execution.

• Programming/Scripting: Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., JavaScript/Python) for test scenario creation and data generation.

• Backend Knowledge: Strong understanding of database performance tuning (PostgreSQL), caching, and API behavior (REST/JSON).

• Cloud/Infra: Familiarity with cloud-based load testing services and containerized environments (Docker).

AI Agent Focus
You will validate the capacity and latency of our AI services.

• Load Testing AI: Conduct stress and load tests on the AI agent systems, measuring latency and throughput under concurrent user requests, especially concerning the processing power required for LLM interactions (e.g., prompt processing, RAG retrieval).

• Resource Impact: Analyze the impact of AI compute demands on shared infrastructure resources, providing data for cloud capacity planning.

Success Metrics & Career Path
Performance will be measured by:

• Latency Reduction: Measurable improvements in API response times (e.g., 95th percentile latency) for critical services.

• Throughput: Successful validation of system throughput capabilities against business-defined peak load targets.

• Bottleneck Identification: Accuracy and impact of identified performance bottlenecks and recommended solutions.

Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Automation QA Lead or Technical Architect, working directly with the SRE and Backend Engineering teams to ensure performance is a core product feature.

Operating at the intersection of research, engineering, infrastructure, and deployment, the team translates emerging compute requirements into validated electrical designs, reference architectures, prototypes, and scalable infrastructure solutions.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Data Center Electrical R&D Design Engineer to develop and validate next-generation power architectures for high-density AI infrastructure.

This role is focused on research, advanced design, modeling, prototyping, and technical validation rather than ongoing facility operations. You will investigate emerging electrical technologies, develop system-level architectures, and evaluate new approaches to utility integration, power distribution, backup generation, energy storage, controls, and rack-level power delivery.

You will work closely with compute hardware, mechanical, controls, construction, commissioning, operations, and external technology partners. Your work will shape reusable reference designs that can move from concept and simulation through pilot testing and large-scale deployment.

- Develop prototypes, test plans, acceptance criteria, and validation frameworks for new electrical technologies and system architectures.

- Lead laboratory, factory, pilot-site, and field testing to validate design assumptions and identify performance or integration gaps.

- Partner with mechanical and thermal engineers to optimize power and cooling architectures as an integrated system.

- Collaborate with AI hardware and compute teams to understand workload behavior, rack density, utilization, power variability, and future platform requirements.

- Work with controls and software teams to define instrumentation, telemetry, protection, monitoring, and automated-control requirements.

- Partner with construction, commissioning, and operations teams to ensure new designs can be safely built, tested, operated, and maintained.

- Engage equipment manufacturers, utilities, engineering consultants, and research partners to evaluate capabilities and accelerate technology development.

- Investigate system failures and unexpected test results, identify root causes, and translate findings into design improvements.

- Document validated designs, technical decisions, operating envelopes, lessons learned, and deployment guidance.

- Provide technical direction and design-review leadership across internal teams and external engineering partners.

Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in electrical engineering, power-system design, data-center infrastructure, industrial power, or another critical-infrastructure environment.

Root was founded on the belief that car insurance is broken, and we set out to change it. We’re harnessing the power of technology to revolutionize this archaic, complicated industry. Using machine learning and mobile telematic platforms, we’ve built one of the most innovative insurtech companies in the world.

The Opportunity

We believe that a disruptive insurance company must have a principled quantitative framework at its foundation. At Root, we are committed to the rigorous development and effective deployment of modern statistical machine learning methods to problems in the insurance industry.

Root is seeking a Staff Data Scientist I to lead the design, development, and oversight of the models that power our customer lifetime value ecosystem. This ecosystem includes hundreds of interdependent models and workflows covering conversion, retention, future premium, and claim losses. Its complexity and business importance require a deeply experienced data scientist who can guide and contribute to the team’s most challenging technical work while partnering directly with machine learning engineers on production deployment.

Lifetime value predictions shape some of Root’s most consequential decisions, driving millions of dollars in marketing investment, informing valuations for key business partnerships, and guiding insurance product decisions.

In this role, you will guide the technical work of the team’s data scientists and partner closely with machine learning engineers, data and software engineers, and business teams to improve decisions across Marketing, Finance, Product, and Customer Experience. You will also be a hands-on individual contributor on that work.

This role carries broad technical responsibility for the quality and evolution of lifetime value modeling. You will resolve complex modeling questions and dependencies, evaluate enhancement opportunities, make principled tradeoffs, and establish practical standards for experimentation, validation, and monitoring. In partnership with the team manager, you will help shape quarterly priorities and longer-term technical direction.

The ideal candidate combines deep modeling expertise and strong execution with the ability to improve the work of others. You can personally deliver complex analyses and models, exercise sound judgment across a highly complex ML system, and help develop other data scientists.

Salary Range : $171,400 - $214,200 (Eligible for competitive bonus and equity offering)

Root is a “work where it works best” company. Meaning we will support you working in whatever location that works best for you across the US. We will continue to have our headquarters in Columbus, Ohio.

How You Will Make an Impact

•
Own the technical direction of LTV modeling. Frame ambiguous problems, weigh analytical options, make principled tradeoffs, and change course as new evidence emerges.

•
Improve the models that drive major decisions. Lead complex initiatives across interconnected conversion, retention, future-premium, and claim-loss models; understand how component models interact, diagnose underperformance, and prioritize improvements by business value.

•
Keep a complex codebase healthy. Guide the design and evolution of the LTV codebase so it remains modular, tested, efficient, extensible, and readable as models and dependencies grow.

•
Stay hands-on across the lifecycle. Contribute directly to exploratory analysis, feature development, modeling, deployment, monitoring, and production support.

•
Measure what matters. Design experiments and validation frameworks with clear success criteria, then evaluate model performance and business impact after launch.

•
Help plan and deliver quarterly and long-term priorities. Partner with the team manager to sequence work around capacity, milestones, and dependencies; communicate risks early and help remove blockers.

•
Partner across the business. Work with machine learning, data, and software engineers to ship reliable model

- At least three years in customer service, ideally with Freshdesk, Zendesk or a similar help desk

title: Senior Embedded/Firmware Engineer (with Linux)
description:
If you're an Embedded / Firmware Engineer who is just as comfortable on a Linux board as on a microcontroller, and you know that a boot hang or a flaky BLE connection is rarely "just a software bug," we'd love to talk.
We're looking for a freelancer with a strong embedded foundation: C/C++, hardware-aware debugging, and real embedded Linux experience (Yocto or Buildroot, U-Boot, kernel, device tree, drivers). The role is not tied to one platform: depending on the project, you might work on a Cortex-A SoC, a Raspberry Pi-class board, or a Cortex-M microcontroller next to it.
You'd join us on a freelance, time & material basis: you're paid for the hours you actually work on real client projects. We're ready to start right away. The first three months are about getting to know each other, and if it works, we'd love to bring you into our core team with a fixed salary and the full benefits package. Not a promise, a real possibility we actively root for.
About intent

We've been designing and co-creating connected devices since 2008. Wearables, smart audio, health-tech hardware, and IoT products for clients like Oura, BOSE, Neurable, and McIntosh. We're a 60+ person, fully remote team that works at the intersection of physical and digital products.
At intent , firmware is not treated as an isolated layer. It sits right in the middle of hardware, mobile, cloud, QA, and product decisions. That means you'll work with people who care about what actually happens on the device, not just what the ticket said should happen.
Who this role is NOT for
If you only want to be handed a perfectly written spec, disappear for two weeks, and return with a pull request, we're probably not your people.
Embedded work at intent means dealing with real-world constraints: imperfect hardware, changing client needs, boards that boot on the bench and not in the enclosure, radios that behave differently in the lab than in the field, power trade-offs, vendor BSPs, datasheets, errata, and edge cases that don't always show up on day one.
We're looking for someone who asks "why?" before jumping into implementation, who can read a schematic and question it, and who understands that "it works on my desk" is not the same as "it works in the product."
Requirements

• 4+ years of professional experience in embedded or firmware development.

• Strong hands-on experience with C / C++ for embedded systems.

• Hands-on experience with embedded Linux build systems such as Yocto Project or Buildroot.

• Good understanding of the Linux kernel, device drivers, and the device tree.

• CI/CD experience for embedded projects (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).

• Experience with bootloaders, particularly U-Boot.

• Experience with embedded constraints: timing, memory, peripherals, boot time, and power consumption.

• Ability to debug firmware and hardware-adjacent problems using practical tools: JTAG/SWD, serial logs, logic analyzers, and oscilloscopes.

• Comfort reading schematics, datasheets, technical documentation, and errata.

• Familiarity with common embedded interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, or similar.

• Proficiency with Bash and/or Python for automation and testing.

• Solid Git skills and comfort collaborating on GitHub: pull requests, code reviews, shared repos.

• Good command of written and spoken English, minimum B2.

• Ownership, self-reliance, and responsibility for assigned work.

• Clear communication, with engineers, PMs, QA, and clients.

• A problem-solving mindset over line-counting.

Nice to have

• Experience with different platforms (even exotic ones).

• Embedded Linux toolchains, drivers, and user-space apps.

• Experience with microcontrollers (ARM Cortex-M) and RTOS such as FreeRTOS or Zephyr.

• Bluetooth / BLE beyond the basics: GATT design, pairing and bonding, connection parameters, throughput and power trade-offs, and secure OTA/DFU.

• Networking: TCP/IP, Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and IoT protocols such as MQTT.

• Multimedia and audio:

title: Principal Software Development Engineer - QA + Networking
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Principal Software Development Engineer to join our team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, India reporting to the Director Software Engineering in the Engineering department. You will join the team that built the world’s largest cloud security platform from the ground up, enabling organizations worldwide to harness speed and agility with a cloud-first strategy. With more than 100 patents and 15 million users across 185 countries, you will bring your vision to a team of experts dedicated to enhancing our multitenant architecture and global footprint.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams during the design phase and maintain cloud-based software solutions

• Design and develop innovative test strategies to simulate complex customer usage scenarios and test at scale using Python

• Develop and maintain robust, scalable test automation frameworks and integrate automated APIs into CI/CD systems (Jenkins/GitLab)

• Take ownership of diagnosing and resolving customer issues, recreating production issues, and providing necessary workarounds for resolution

• Provide critical insights to the development team to enhance product debugging and serviceability features

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You are a problem-solver who is energized by finding solutions to complex technical challenges and delivering high-impact outcomes.

• You are customer-obsessed, anchoring your decisions in solving real-world customer issues and championing their needs from start to finish.

• You are a high-trust collaborator who thrives in a team environment, giving and receiving candid feedback to build trust and achieve shared goals.

• You are a learner with a growth mindset, constantly developing your technical skills and actively integrating feedback to improve.

• You operate with urgency and maintain a strong bias for action, delivering high-impact, high-quality results in a dynamic environment.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• Extensive experience with TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS/TLS, and proficient with L4-L7 protocols, certificates, and debugging network flows using tools like tcpdump and Wireshark

title: Cloud Engineer Azure Databricks
description:
Cloud Engineer Azure Databricks
Senior Cloud Engineer - Azure Infrastructure & Databricks Platform
Alternate titles that reach the same candidate pool: Senior Cloud Platform Engineer (Azure & Databricks) · Senior Azure Infrastructure Engineer - Data Platform · Senior Cloud Engineer, Databricks Platform

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer to design, implement, and administer the Azure infrastructure behind our enterprise data and AI platform. This is a cloud infrastructure and platform engineering position centered on Azure Databricks, ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Machine Learning.

You will own the platform foundation - infrastructure as code, network and identity architecture, compute governance, observability, and cost management - and partner closely with our Databricks administration, data engineering, and data science teams. Our group defines the platform standards and reference architectures those teams build within, which means depth in Databricks administration matters here as much as depth in Azure. You should be equally at home provisioning a workspace through Terraform and advising on Unity Catalog design, cluster policy, or identity federation.

This role suits an engineer who enjoys being the technical reference point for a platform: setting the architectural direction, partnering with adjacent teams on complex problems, and translating business requirements into the platform capabilities needed to support them.

Part One - Infrastructure Ownership

Design, implement, and administer the Azure foundation the platform runs on.

• Infrastructure as Code (Terraform-first): Author and maintain the reusable Terraform modules that provision the Azure data estate - Databricks workspaces, ADLS Gen2, Data Factory, Key Vault, networking, and Azure ML. Own remote state, module versioning, drift detection, and the pipelines that deploy them.

• Network & Security Architecture: Design and implement the private networking and security posture for the platform - private endpoints, hub-and-spoke topology, VNet injection, NSGs and firewall rules, managed identities, Key Vault-backed secret scopes, RBAC, and data exfiltration controls.

• Data Lake Infrastructure: Own ADLS Gen2 at the infrastructure layer: storage account architecture, hierarchical namespace, container and ACL strategy, lifecycle and tiering policy, encryption and key management, and access patterns for Databricks and downstream consumers.

• Data Factory Platform Operations: Own ADF from the platform side - integration runtime provisioning and scaling (self-hosted and managed VNet), linked service credential and managed identity design, environment promotion, deployment automation, and monitoring. Pipeline development sits with the data engineering team.

• AI/ML Platform Infrastructure: Provision and operate the infrastructure supporting machine learning workloads: Azure ML workspaces and compute clusters, GPU quota and capacity planning, MLflow model registry integration, model serving endpoints, and the identity and networking connecting them to Unity Catalog.

• Observability & Reliability: Build and maintain the monitoring layer - Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, diagnostic settings, alerting, and operational runbooks across the estate.

• FinOps & Capacity Planning: Own cost visibility and optimization across DBU and storage spend - tagging strategy, chargeback and showback, budget alerts, reserved capacity, and forward capacity planning.

• CI/CD & Environment Management: Own the deployment pipelines and promotion path across development, test, and production environments.

Part Two - Databricks Platform Administration

Day-to-day Databricks operations are supported by a dedicated administration team. This role establishes the platform standards and reference configurations that team works from, and serves as a senior technical partner on architecture, design decisions, and complex escalations. Our work spans safeguards research and deployment, safety assessments, launch readiness, and trusted-access programs for advanced capabilities. We address risks including biological and cyber misuse and misalignment, with programs that strengthen safety across models and products.

About the Role

We’re hiring Research Program Managers across AI Safeguards and Frontier Risks Safety. You’ll lead programs that develop and improve the safeguards used across our models and products, or assess and mitigate risks associated with frontier capabilities, launches, and trusted-access programs.

You will partner with researchers, engineers, and other stakeholders to turn open safety questions into clear programs of work. You’ll shape technical roadmaps, coordinate execution, and use evidence to guide priorities and inform development and deployment decisions. We’re looking for people who combine strong technical judgment, experience managing complex research programs, and a commitment to AI safety.

These roles are based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

Organize capability evaluations, alignment and control assessments, adversarial testing, and safeguard stress-testing, including risks from autonomous and multi-agent systems. Support embedded assessments throughout model development, internal use, and deployment.

- Drive safety readiness and trusted-access programs. Coordinate safety requirements and execution across frontier model launches and deployments. Work with technical teams to define assessment scope and the evidence needed to inform safety and access decisions.

- Strengthen the evidence behind safety decisions. Support safety cases that connect claims to evaluations, safeguards, assumptions, and remaining uncertainty. Surface evidence gaps and unresolved risks, and communicate methods, results, limitations, and follow-up actions through assessment reports, system cards, and updates to decision-makers.

title: Technical Director
description:
INVNT is a global experiential marketing and brand storytelling agency that specializes in live events, digital experiences, and integrated campaigns that drive audience engagement and brand growth. Our team of creative strategists, producers, and innovators helps Fortune 500 companies, cultural icons, and purpose-driven organizations bring their brand stories to life. With a proven track record in innovation, strategy, and execution, INVNT blends creativity with results to help brands break through noise, connect with audiences, and leave lasting impressions worldwide.
We are looking to add a Technical Director to our Technical Dept. The Technical Director translates creative concepts into actionable, structurally sound technical realities for individual projects. Responsible for the technical pre-production, CAD drafting, and on-site execution of assigned shows, the TD manages day-to-day vendor deliverables, coordinates venue logistics, and ensures the technical build is completed safely, on time, and within budget.
You will report directly to the Senior Director of Technical Services. Position may be done remotely with the ability to travel to various events.
Salary is $200,000
What you’ll do:

• Analyze creative concepts and generate comprehensive technical specifications, equipment manifests, and structural build plans.

• Create detailed, accurate site plans, ground plans, rigging plots, and sections using industry-standard design software.

• Build and manage detailed technical line-item budgets for assigned projects; track expenses and process vendor change orders.

• Solicit, evaluate, and negotiate individual vendor quotes for staging, audio, video, lighting, and scenic elements.

• Call the load-in, setup, strike, and load-out on show site; manage local labor and vendor crews to ensure adherence to safety regulations and design specs.

• Coordinate directly with venue technical managers regarding power drops, rigging points, loading docks, and local permitting requirements.

• 5-7 years of hands-on experience working as a Technical Director or Associate Technical Director in live events, theater, or corporate experiential production.

• Proficient, daily drafting experience in Vectorworks, AutoCAD, or SketchUp.

• Strong working knowledge of standard rigging practices, scenic construction methods, power distribution, and fundamental audio, video, and lighting engineering.

• Proven track record of successfully managing crew labor and vendors under tight timelines on active show sites.

• weekends) as dictated by show schedules.

• Strong aptitude for real-time troubleshooting, structural math, and spatial reasoning
